Non-skipped DP synchronization uses CPU packed2×DP tensor with each rank writing its own column; default all_reduce sums disjoint columns. Token maximum and minimum graph mode are then computed explicitly. Global token count is max,not sum of DP counts; one NONE mode makes synchronized modeNONE.

DP skip policy is recomputed per call: hierarchy or MegaMoe-supported first forces no-skip; dense context skips; ordinary MoE non-KV-consumer does not skip; KV consumer may skip only under remaining communication/recompute/mode conditions and no CANN MegaMoe. Do not memoize merely by config object id or infer skip from MC2 name.
